**Inventoried brain's machine-readable state for the dashboard exercise (#851)**

**What**: Mapped every state source a Brain UI dashboard could read without inventing a second source of truth. Full report saved locally at ~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/design-docs/brain-ui-state-inventory-2026-09-06.md.

**Why**: Maintainer asked (2026-09-06) to design a real-time management UI (devs + project leads): task graph, spec/tasks readable, cold-review round summaries, ADRs, anti-patterns, roadmap, per-actor progress. Issue #851 has an unmerged RFC (worktree brain-issue-851, no PR) covering DAG+telemetry+MCP but none of the management views.

**Where**: Structured and reusable in-process: status/epic-graph.mjs buildGraph(), lib/sdd-layout.mjs, status/derive*.mjs, review/lib/parse-verdict.mjs + board.mjs reconcileOnePr + queue.mjs gatherQueue, vcs/cli.mjs port verbs, .memory/records jsonl (actor/actorKind), resume-schema.mjs, status/release-debt.mjs, brain:metrics --json (the ONLY json CLI emitter).

**Learned**: (1) No HTTP/MCP server or brain:ui exists. (2) Only the LATEST brain-review/2 verdict per PR is parseable; round history is just the forge comment timeline and the port has no comment-read verb. (3) Roadmap, ADR index, anti-pattern index and per-actor rollups are prose-only. (4) Two agent-name lists coexist: governance.agentActors/brain.aiAgents vs a hardcoded regex in review/evaluators/tranche.mjs:59. Recommendation given: cold-source-first UI, telemetry/MCP later; every shown fact reconstructible from repo+tickets.
